snip.t: A 72-year-old male with symptomatic third-degree atrioventricular block and a ventricular escape rhythm of 32 bpm is awaiting transvenous pacing.
Electrical complications: Ventricular tachycardia, ventricular fibrillation, sinus bradycardia, and high-degree atrioventricular block (common in RCA/inferior infarctions).
snip.s: Acute coronary syndrome and myocardial infarction

snip.t: Atrioventricular blocks: Symptomatic Mobitz II and third-degree AV blocks require permanent pacemaker implantation.
